Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //wow.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 45 s. 2023 JUN 20 2023 HON. FERDINAND T. GAVIOLA Mayor, San Sebastian Samar Dear Mayor Gaviola: This refers to your letter dated November 18, 2022 requesting legal assistance premised on the circumstances of the concerned local officials' assumption to the positions of a Municipal Mayor and Municipal Vice Mayor and that of a Sangguniang Bayan Member, all in acting capacities. The relevant facts are as follows: • The vice mayor-elect, Eleuterio Mabao, and sangguniang bayan member, Rebecca S. Mabulay, took their oath and assumed the positions of municipal mayor and municipal vice mayor, respectively, in an acting capacity, on 12 February 2020. Thus, in view of the temporary vacancy created in the sanggunian bayan, Ms. Lea B. Amatosa was designated as acting sangguniang bayan member on 1 June 2021 by virtue of a Memorandum dated 20 May 2021. • Acting Mayor Eleutario Mabao took an oath as full fledge municipal mayor on 27 October 2021, while Acting Vice Mayor Rebecca S. Mabulay took an oath as full fledge Vice Mayor on November 2021. A study of the facts and issues submitted for resolution deemed it necessary for this level to simplify the problem statements into one core issue, that is, the entitlement to salaries and benefits of the officials who assumed as acting municipal mayor, Municipal Vice Mayor and Sangguniang Bayan member positions during the period of temporary vacancy and from the time the vacancy was declared permanent. During the period when a vice mayor assumes the position of the mayor and the ISt sangguniang bayan member assumes the position of the vice mayor, in an acting capacity, the concerned public officials are not entitled to salaries and emoluments of the position they assumed. A plethora of DILG Opinions have been rendered in this wise anchored on the express provision of Section 445 (4) that to exercise the powers and perform the duties and functions of the municipal mayor in cases of temporary vacancy as provided for in section 46, Book I, of the Local Government Code, is one of the powers and functions of the municipal vice mayor. Likewise, in case of temporary vacancy in the office of the municipal vice mayor, DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2019-21 dated 12 February 2019 dictates that the highest ranking "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

sangguniang bayan member shall be designated by the president, through the SILG/OIC-DILG, as acting municipal vice mayor. Thus, both cases of assumption of office in an acting capacity is deemed an integral power and functions of their office as vice mayor and ISt ranking sangguniang member which do not entitle them to the salaries and emoluments of the positions they assumed. As such, the assumed responsibilities are deemed fully compensated by their salaries from their regular positions. In the case of the temporary vacancy in the office of the sanggunian resulting from the assumption of the ISt ranking sanggunian member to the office of the vice mayor, the case different from the case of acting mayor and acting vice mayor. Since the temporary vacancy is to be filled-up through designation of sanggunian members by the President through the SILG or the OIC-DILG, the designated official shall naturally be entitled to the salaries, benefits and emoluments of a regular member of the sanggunian. The rationale is that the designated official is not occupying any elective position in the first place prior to his designation to as acting sanggunian member and the government cannot do so without providing due compensation therefor. Going further, if one is to question the source of fund from which the salaries and benefits of the acting sangguniang member is to be derived considering that the acting vice mayor shall still be paid with salary from the personal service budget allocated for his position as sangguniang member, we advise that the salaries of the acting sanggunian member may still be charged against the personal services budget subject to compliance to Local Budget Circular No. 98, specifically, Item 5.3 thereof which provides that vacant and new positions shall be adequately provided with appropriations for salaries, allowances and benefits, and fixed personnel expenditures to back up their legal existence, otherwise they should be abolished. Otherwise, the same should be a subject of supplemental appropriations for personal services subject to the limitations provided under Section 325(a) of the Local Government Code, to wit: The total appropriations, whether annual or supplemental, for personal services of a local government unit for one (1) fiscal year shall not exceed forty-five percent (45%) in the case of first to third class provinces, cities, and municipalities, and fifty-five percent (55%) in the case of fourth class or lower, of the total annual income from regular sources realized in the next preceding fiscal year. The appropriations for salaries, wages, representation 139 and transportation allowances of officials and employees of the public utilities and economic enterprises owned, operated, and maintained by the local government unit concerned shall not be included in the annual budget or in the computation of the maximum amount for personal services. The appropriations for the personal services of such economic enterprises shall be charged to their respective budgets; It is respectfully submitted that Hon. Eleuterio Mabao, and Hon. Rebecca S. Mabulay are rightfully entitled to the salaries and emoluments of a mayor and vice mayor only from the time they took oath and assumed as full-fledged mayor and vice mayor respectively. On the other hand, we affirm the statement of Usec. Marlo Iringan, as quoted in the letter, that Hon. Amatosa is entitled to the salaries and other benefits of an SB member from June 1, 2021 , the time of his designation in an acting capacity. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts.

We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY RITY OF THE SECRETARY: J AN VICTOR R. LLAMAS cretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs Und OUSELLAJVRULLLS-LRALLD/kbm1cl copy furnished: ARNEL M. AGABE Regional Director, DILG-Region VIII Kanhuraw Hill, Tacloban City
